# Trueline IT

> Done-for-you AI and phone services for four kinds of business: trades and contractors, salons and clinics, professional firms (law firms, accountants, financial advisors, insurance agencies, consulting firms, and architecture and engineering firms), and property managers. Trades and contractors get an AI receptionist, missed-call text-back, quote follow-up, chat-to-text, text-to-pay and contractor websites. Salons and clinics get an AI receptionist, Google review requests and appointment reminders. Property managers get help with leases, vendor invoices, resident questions and owner leads. Professional firms get AI governance. We set it up and run it. Call (647) 360-5774 for trades, salon and property-manager services.

## AI governance ladder (forms)
For law firms, accountants, financial advisors, insurance agencies, consulting firms, and architecture and engineering firms that want to use AI safely, done for you: written AI use policies, checks for unapproved AI tools, Microsoft 365 Copilot setup, and staff training. Set up with PIPEDA in mind. This is guidance and setup, not legal advice.
